en_title: Microsoft Reportedly Working to Bring Xbox 360 Games to PC and Project Helix
cn_title: 微软拟将XBOX 360游戏带到PC/Project Helix
subtitle: 实体盘还有救？
opus_summary: 据泄露文件，微软可能允许开发者将XBOX 360游戏带到PC、Project Helix主机及掌机，相关作品预计在2027年至2028年逐步推出兼容版本。实体盘或可绑定数字授权并转移给新持有者，但计划仍未正式确认。

paragraphs.en: Microsoft reportedly has plans to allow developers to bring their Xbox 360 games to PC, as well as other Xbox devices.
paragraphs.cn: 据报道，微软计划允许开发者将XBOX 360游戏带到PC以及其他XBOX设备上。

paragraphs.en: That's according to a leaked document sent to Microsoft's partners that was seen by The Verge . What appeared to be a portion of the document showing a roadmap for features set to come in the coming months and years also leaked over the weekend.
paragraphs.cn: The Verge看到的一份发给微软合作伙伴的泄露文件披露了这一消息。周末也有疑似文件片段泄露，其中展示了未来数月和数年将推出功能的路线图。

paragraphs.en: it looks like devs won’t have to do any engineering work to get Xbox 360 and Xbox games on PC. Microsoft’s Xbox PC emulator handles it all 👍 https://t.co/3veMXdaJb2 pic.twitter.com/daFEomcVUa
paragraphs.cn: 看起来，开发者无需进行任何工程工作，就能让XBOX 360和XBOX游戏登陆PC。微软的XBOX PC模拟器会处理好一切👍 https://t.co/3veMXdaJb2 pic.twitter.com/daFEomcVUa

paragraphs.en: The alleged plan is to allow players to play classic Xbox 360 titles not only on "Xbox PCs," but the upcoming Project Helix console and handheld hardware, as well. Microsoft previously announced a similar strategy in July, though backward compatibility on that front was limited to original Xbox games .
paragraphs.cn: 据称，这项计划不仅允许玩家在「XBOX PC」上游玩经典XBOX 360作品，也能在即将推出的Project Helix主机和掌机硬件上游玩。微软此前曾在7月宣布类似策略，但当时的向下兼容仅限于初代XBOX游戏。

paragraphs.en: The report added that developers will have the freedom to bring their Xbox 360 games to the aforementioned devices – but the feature won't officially launch for some time. Potentially eligible titles aren't expected to begin their gradual rollout on next-gen Xbox hardware until sometime between 2027 and 2028. At that point, the expectation is reportedly that developers will be able to make their games backward compatible. They will also maintain control over pricing and Game Pass availability.
paragraphs.cn: 报道还称，开发者可以自由决定是否将XBOX 360游戏带到上述设备，但这项功能还要过一段时间才会正式推出。符合条件的作品预计要到2027年至2028年间，才会开始逐步登陆次世代XBOX硬件。届时，据称开发者将能够让自己的游戏实现向下兼容，同时继续掌控定价和Game Pass的上架情况。

paragraphs.en: Original Xbox games were set to begin disc-to-digital testing for insiders last month, with availability for all coming this month. The Verge reported that the beta was delayed, so when that's still in the cards for is unclear.
paragraphs.cn: 初代XBOX游戏原定于上月开始面向内部测试者进行光盘转数字版测试，并在本月向所有人开放。The Verge报道称，测试版已经延期，因此这项计划何时仍会推进尚不清楚。

paragraphs.en: The Verge reported early last month that Microsoft was exploring ways for players to digitally transfer their physical games . Today's report added some clarity to that, stating that physical Xbox One and Xbox Series X games placed in console disc drives will grant players a digital license that is bound to "that disc and the player's account." However, should a disc be traded with someone else, digital ownership can be swapped to that person.
paragraphs.cn: The Verge上月初报道称，微软正在探索让玩家以数字方式转移实体游戏的方法。今天的报道进一步说明，放入主机光驱的实体XBOX One和XBOX Series X游戏会赋予玩家一份绑定于「该光盘和玩家账户」的数字授权。不过，如果光盘被转卖给他人，数字所有权也可以转移给对方。

paragraphs.en: In other words, should this strategy pan out, trading eligible Xbox discs will work similarly to how it has before we started careening toward an all-digital future. It's unclear if it's a solution that will be celebrated by players who have fought for physical media to stay.
paragraphs.cn: 换句话说，如果这项策略最终落地，符合条件的XBOX光盘交易方式将与我们一路冲向全数字化未来之前大致相同。目前尚不清楚，这一方案是否会得到那些一直争取保留实体媒介的玩家欢迎。

paragraphs.en: The conversation surrounding how gaming company's are slowely doing away with physical media has heated up in recent months. Rockstar Games sparked fears online when it announced Grand Theft Auto 6 would launch with a code in its box instead of a disc . Those fears were then realized when Sony declared it would cease production for physical games starting in January 2028 , a decision it's .
paragraphs.cn: 近几个月，围绕游戏公司如何逐渐取消实体媒介的讨论持续升温。Rockstar Games宣布《GTA6》发售时盒内会放置兑换码而非光盘，引发了网上的担忧。随后，索尼宣布将从2028年1月起停止生产实体游戏，这些担忧也变成了现实，不过这一决定的后续影响仍有待观察。

paragraphs.en: How Microsoft will fit into an increasingly heavy digital gaming landscape remains to be seen, but it wouldn't be a surprise to see it do away with physical releases, too. While we wait to see how the future will pan out, you can see how Sony responded to the backlash last week . You can also read up on the Xbox console price increases that swept across Europe over the weekend.
paragraphs.cn: 微软将如何融入日益偏向数字化的游戏市场仍有待观察，但即使它也取消实体发售，相信大家不会感到意外。在等待未来走向明朗的同时，你可以看看索尼上周如何回应相关反弹，也可以阅读上周末席卷欧洲的XBOX主机涨价报道。
